newsitem.title: USA: CBOT July wheat up 20-ct limit as EU halts exports.
newsitem.headline: CBOT July wheat up 20-ct limit as EU halts exports.

text.p: CBOT July wheat futures rallied the 20-cent-a-bushel trading limit and all contracts were in fast trading on news the EU halted wheat exports, traders said.
Grain officials said the European Commission closed its tenders for export licenses for 1996-97 wheat from the open market.
At 1224 CDT, wheat was 15 to 19 cents per bushel higher, with May up 18-1/4 at $4.25. July was up 18-1/2 at $4.34.
